Context: 6. Enhancement of ceiling of HBA sanctioned on or after 1-1-2016 but before 9-11-2017.-

conditions: -  
- (i) The employee should not have drawn the entire amount of HBA sanctioned under earlier orders and/ or where construction is not completed/full cost towards acquisition of house/flat is yet to be paid.
- There will be no deviation from the approved plan of construction on the basis of which the original sanction of House Building Advance was accorded. The revised cost of the original plan can, however, be considered for determining the additional amount,
